commit.message:
breaking: make pagination mandatory - default to first page (#13960)

The page and limit parameters to many Forgejo APIs have previously been optional, and if not provided have been interpreted as "retrieve all data". Forgejo will now default page to 1, and default limit to [api].DEFAULT_PAGING_NUM (default: 30).

Reviewed-on: https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/13960
Reviewed-by: Mathieu Fenniak <redacted@example.invalid>

commit.message:
perf: avoid unnecessary queries for release API endpoint (#15265)

When retrieving the releases from the database it does one query per release to look up the repository that release belongs to (for details like download link etc). The handler (/repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases) already had that repo.

In other words: for an API call with 50 releases there were 50 identical, unneeded queries.

Reviewed-on: https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/15265
Reviewed-by: Mathieu Fenniak <redacted@example.invalid>
